verdict.rationale: Natural-language tasking is Browser Use's core interaction model. Runs are created from plain-English goals such as "Find the top Hacker News story", and the GitHub examples include tasks like "Fill in this job application with my resume". Sessions support multi-run conversations, the MCP server lets users issue tasks from Claude or Cursor, and community users report hands-on success with the natural-language agent. Missing for 10: a documented standalone conversational end-user interface beyond the API, SDK and MCP entry points, and broader independent evidence on how reliably commands are interpreted.
